notes: V07's ephemeral signing key is compromised: a new manifest with a higher sequence number rotates it (Manifest.h:44-76). V11's master key is compromised: a manifest with sequence 0xFFFFFFFF revokes it and the validator leaves the UNL; the validation quorum recomputes from 35 to 34 validators.
severity_reason: V07 signing-key compromise recovered by 1 manifest rotation (sequence 1 -> 2) with no validation interruption. V11 master-key compromise required 1 revocation manifest (sequence 0xFFFFFFFF); the validator left the UNL (35 -> 34) and the quorum recomputed 24 -> 23.
title: Compromised validator key: manifest rotation recovers a signing key, revocation removes a master key
